notes:
Warbanner 0.3.0 - Realistic soldiers (proof of concept).
The soldiers are now motion-capture-ready Mixamo men-at-arms in great helms and tabards (Castle Guard), animated on their own skeleton with all the Mixamo moves; the tabards take the team colour. The previous Quaternius soldiers can be switched back.
In a melee the regiments no longer wheel round each other or walk their men backwards: the front holds and the men fight along it, stepping round less.
